# True Precision Engineering Ltd

> ISO 9001 certified, family-run sub-contract precision engineering company in Blaydon-on-Tyne, Tyne and Wear (near Newcastle upon Tyne and Gateshead), UK. Established 1989. Provides CNC turning, CNC milling, grinding, toolmaking (jigs, fixtures, press and mould tools), light fabrication and mechanical assembly to customers across the North East, the UK and beyond.

## Key facts

- Company: True Precision Engineering Ltd
- Founded: 1989, as a small family-run business
- Facility: over 12,500 sq. ft. factory, Ryton Industrial Estate, Newburn Bridge Road, Blaydon-on-Tyne, NE21 4SQ, United Kingdom
- Quality: ISO 9001 quality management system, certified by NQA (UKAS accredited)
- Phone: 0191 414 2959 (+44 191 414 2959)
- Email: sales@trueprecisionengineering.co.uk, jackie@trueprecisionengineering.co.uk
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–4:30pm (UK time)
- Workshop: 24-hour on-call by phone or email; hours can be extended to suit customers
- Batch sizes: one-off parts, prototypes, and large or small production batches
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/true-precision-engineering-limited/

## Plant and capacity

- CNC turning with live tooling: up to 700 mm swing, 2,000 mm between centres
- Centre lathes: up to 550 mm swing, 2,000 mm between centres
- CNC milling, 21-station turret: 750 × 500 mm table
- Turret milling, universal milling, jig boring and drilling, slotting
- Surface grinding up to 200 × 450 mm
- Light fabrication in-house; larger fabrications with surface coating via supply partners
- Complete design, manufacture and final or part assembly

## Products produced

CNC machining centre work; precision machined components; jigs and fixtures; press and mould tools; production line components; assembly work; light fabrication; large and small batches.
